adaptive: depth 5, cutoff 0.01 if real root max <3072; 0.005 if max >=3072, including >=6144
common: modern rules; zero leaf clamp; no node cap or wall-time cap; standard nine-card starts; stop at 12288 or death; 50000-move guard errors
pairing: same opening seeds; subsequent events are not one-to-one after policy divergence
analysis: two-sided exact McNemar for each primary; Holm familywise alpha .05 for two tests; Wilson 95% intervals per arm; approximate paired difference 95% intervals; score/moves secondary descriptive
stopping: fixed 1024 pairs; no interim outcome analysis; failure pauses/resumes same immutable configuration
browserCheck: after native load ends, compare fixed and adaptive on the same fixed archived 3072 and 6144 boards, 160ms soft budget; report mean/p95/max and completed-depth share separately; a desktop-only check
adoption: recommend only with Holm-significant improvement in at least one primary, no observed decline in the other, and >=99% full depth 5 in each browser phase with p95 <160ms; otherwise retain baseline or report inconclusive; no website deployment in this test
limits: not a deterministic optimality claim; 12288 rare-event power may be limited; selection/training histories stay unchanged
